strategies.label: Index-matched trend
strategies.desc: One slow EWMA trend filter at group delay 110, class budgets fitted once to the SG CTA index and frozen, 10% vol target. The flagship book.
strategies.rule: EWMATrend gd 110 · cap ±2 · class budget rates 36 / equities 22 / commodities 22 / FX 19 / VIX 1 · VolCorr gearing · 10% target, 4× cap

strategies.label: Trend ensemble, four speeds
strategies.desc: Four EWMA trend filters at group delays 42, 63, 84 and 126, averaged. Faster and broader than the index-matched book.
strategies.rule: EWMATrend gd 42 / 63 / 84 / 126, equally weighted · cap ±2 · equal weight by name · 10% target

strategies.label: Shop replica
strategies.desc: A replica of a trend shop's production signal set: moving-average crossovers from 8/32 to 64/256 on vol-scaled returns.
strategies.rule: EWMA crossovers 8/32, 16/64, 32/128, 64/256 · cap ±2 · equal weight · 10% target

strategies.label: Slow trend, long only
strategies.desc: EWMAC 64/256, sign only, shorts set to zero.

strategies.label: Slow trend, binary
strategies.desc: EWMAC 64/256, sign only, long and short.

strategies.label: Slow trend with strength
strategies.desc: EWMAC 64/256 scaled to a forecast and capped at ±20.

strategies.label: Fast trend
strategies.desc: EWMAC 16/64 with strength.

strategies.label: Three trend speeds
strategies.desc: EWMAC 16, 32 and 64 combined; FDM 1.08.

strategies.label: Adjusted trend
strategies.desc: EWMAC 2 to 64 with a double-V on the fastest and rescaled 4 and 64; FDM 1.26.

strategies.label: Trend on the synthetic spot
strategies.desc: EWMAC on the price with accrued carry removed.

strategies.label: Trend on the normalised price
strategies.desc: EWMAC on cumulative vol-scaled returns.

strategies.label: Asset-class trend
strategies.desc: EWMAC on the class's normalised price, applied to every member.

strategies.label: Breakout
strategies.desc: 40 × (price − mid) / range over 10 to 320 days.

strategies.label: Carry
strategies.desc: Vol-adjusted annualised carry, smoothed over 5, 20, 60 and 120 days; FDM 1.04.

strategies.label: Seasonally adjusted carry
strategies.desc: Carry with its seasonal pattern shifted one roll ahead.

strategies.label: Relative carry
strategies.desc: Carry forecast minus the asset-class median, 90-day span. The best single rule on this universe.

strategies.label: Commodity relative momentum
strategies.desc: Rank 41 commodities on past returns over five formation windows; long the strongest, short the weakest. The sleeve that pairs with trend.
strategies.rule: five formation windows · rank within commodities · long/short tails · 10% target

strategies.label: Cross-asset relative momentum
strategies.desc: The same ranking across every asset class, group-neutral.
strategies.rule: five formation windows · rank within class · long/short

strategies.label: Relative momentum, long only
strategies.desc: Hold the top of the ranking only, no shorts.
strategies.rule: five formation windows · top of the ranking, long only

strategies.label: Sector relative momentum
strategies.desc: Ranking at the sector level rather than the asset class.
strategies.rule: five formation windows · rank within sector

strategies.label: Relative momentum, Carver
strategies.desc: EWMAC on the instrument's normalised price minus its asset class's.

strategies.label: Carver book, sleeves
strategies.desc: Fourteen of the book's strategies as sleeves at fixed risk weights: trend 50, carry 25, the rest 25. One portfolio, 10% target.
strategies.rule: 14 sleeves · trend 50 / carry 25 / other 25 · VolTarget 10% · 4× cap

strategies.label: Carver book, one model
strategies.desc: Every rule inside one model at the forecast level: trend 50 / carry 30 / other 20, FDM estimated.
strategies.rule: all rules · forecast weights 50/30/20 · FDM estimated

strategies.label: Trend + commodity relative momentum
strategies.desc: The shop replica and the commodity ranking book at equal risk: two different questions about the same markets, 0.4 correlated.
strategies.rule: trend_shop_replica 50 (RollingSharpe timing) + xs_momentum_commodities 50 · net caps · 10% target

strategies.label: Trend and carry
strategies.desc: Three trend speeds and four carry spans in one forecast; FDM 1.29.

strategies.label: Trend and carry in risk regimes
strategies.desc: Trend forecasts scaled by 2 − 1.5 × the vol quantile; carry untouched.

strategies.label: Trend and carry, dynamically weighted
strategies.desc: 60/40 trend/carry, reweighted by 12-month relative performance.

strategies.label: Buy and hold, risk-scaled
strategies.desc: A constant forecast: long every market at its vol-scaled size.

strategies.label: Value
strategies.desc: Minus the five-year change in the relative normalised price. Wrong-signed on this universe.

strategies.label: Acceleration
strategies.desc: An EWMAC forecast minus its value a span ago.

strategies.label: Skew
strategies.desc: Minus the rolling skew of returns over 60, 120 and 240 days.

strategies.label: Crypto relative momentum
strategies.desc: The fifty most liquid Kraken perpetuals ranked on five formation windows; long the top, short the bottom; 10% target, 30% per-name cap.
strategies.rule: five formation windows · rank across perpetuals · MaxPositionWeight 30% · 10% target, 3× cap
